t: The sum of $1,980 be and the same is hereby set aside, appropriated and authorized to be expended out of "Street Work in Front of City Property," Budget Item No. 34, for the improvement of Miguel street, fronting Fairmount Park, city property.
Commencing at a point at the intersection of the easterly line of Lenox way with the southerly line of Taraval street, thence south 5 degrees 36 minutes 28 seconds west 302.614 feet…
